mapper.insert: INSERT INTO page (id, slug, parent_id, template, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{slug}, #{parentId}, #{template}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO page_translations (page_id, locale, title, content, seo_title, seo_description, seo_open_graph_title, seo_open_graph_description, seo_canonical_url) VALUES (#{pageId}, #{locale}, #{title}, #{content}, #{seoTitle}, #{seoDescription}, #{seoOpenGraphTitle}, #{seoOpenGraphDescription}, #{seoCanonicalUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE page SET slug = #{slug}, parent_id = #{parentId}, template = #{template}, status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.parent_id, p.template, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, t.page_id, t.locale, t.title, t.content, t.seo_title, t.seo_description, t.seo_open_graph_title, t.seo_open_graph_description, t.seo_canonical_url FROM page p LEFT JOIN page_translations t ON p.id = t.page_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.parent_id, p.template, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, t.page_id, t.locale, t.title, t.content, t.seo_title, t.seo_description, t.seo_open_graph_title, t.seo_open_graph_description, t.seo_canonical_url FROM page p LEFT JOIN page_translations t ON p.id = t.page_id WHERE p.slug = #{slug}

SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.parent_id, p.template, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, t.page_id, t.locale, t.title, t.content, t.seo_title, t.seo_description, t.seo_open_graph_title, t.seo_open_graph_description, t.seo_canonical_url FROM ( SELECT id, slug, parent_id, template, status, created_at, updated_at FROM page ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) p LEFT JOIN page_translations t ON p.id = t.page_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.parent_id, p.template, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, t.page_id, t.locale, t.title, t.content, t.seo_title, t.seo_description, t.seo_open_graph_title, t.seo_open_graph_description, t.seo_canonical_url FROM page p INNER JOIN page_translations t ON p.id = t.page_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.parent_id, p.template, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, t.page_id, t.locale, t.title, t.content, t.seo_title, t.seo_description, t.seo_open_graph_title, t.seo_open_graph_description, t.seo_canonical_url FROM page p LEFT JOIN page_translations t ON p.id = t.page_id WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
